title: Here's who Netflix just brought in to run content — and what it means for the streamer
summary: Peter Rice has been appointed as the chief content officer at Netflix, a move that signifies a strategic shift for the streaming giant. With extensive experience in both scripted and unscripted television, as well as live sports and theatrical distribution, Rice is expected to enhance Netflix's content offerings. His background in prestige television indicates a potential focus on high-quality productions that could attract a broader audience.
